purpose: Gate A physical foreground iPhone to Android exchange

internet.verification_method: Device owner confirmed Wi-Fi and mobile data were both off during the exchange.

permissions: Local Network; test app automatically accepts generated-byte verification

android.model: Redmi Note 11 Pro 5G (primary iPhone pairing); Redmi Note 11 Pro 5G and Poco X4 Pro 5G used in the separate three-phone test
permissions: Precise location enabled per device owner

transport.radio_state: Bluetooth enabled for exchange; Wi-Fi radio and mobile data disabled per device owner
transport.consent_or_authentication: Test-only automatic acceptance of the SDK verification code for generated bytes; no user reports or private data were sent

attempts.evidence_source: The full iPhone export records 20 successful attempt results with matching expected and received hashes. The Android completion summary reports 20 successful sends and 20 unique receives.
The full iPhone export records 20 unique receipts with matching expected and received hashes. The Android completion summary reports 20 successful sends and 20 unique receives.

lifecycle.app_background: The iPhone export records the app entering background before peer discovery and exchange; the peer batch completed. The device owner also reports successful app switching and screen locking during the test.
lifecycle.screen_off: Owner-reported test only; the iPhone export labels screen-off delivery unverified.

additional_observations: The Android export is a partial text excerpt beginning at attempt index 13; its completion summary reports 20 successful sends, 0 failed sends and 20 unique receives. The iPhone export contains all 20 local results and all 20 incoming receipts.

After the completed peer batch, Android discovery retries reported status 8034 MISSING_PERMISSION_ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION. The device owner reports precise location was enabled. The exports do not record the runtime permission check result, so the discrepancy remains under investigation in a separate issue.
The three-phone probe uses serial point-to-point encounters; phones did not connect to two peers simultaneously. The device owner reports using both Android phones in that test.
limitations: This gate exchanges synthetic generated bytes, not field reports, and does not test report relevance, encryption or relay routing.
The three-phone result does not establish simultaneous connections or multi-hop delivery.
